Pope Leo XIV has established a new Prison Ministry Pastoral Outreach Service through his Apostolic Letter issued Motu Proprio, “In carcere eram, et venistis ad me” (I was in prison and you visited me). The new service replaces the International Commission of Catholic Prison Pastoral Care and aims to strengthen and coordinate the Church’s pastoral ministry in prisons worldwide. Affiliated with the Dicastery for Promoting Integral Human Development, the initiative will be coordinated by Archbishop Jorge Ignacio García Cuerva of Buenos Aires.
